rationale: I read the complete held EO 13697 (80 FR 36691, June 22, 2015): a short amendment of EO 11155 (Presidential Scholars) with no own-term. No held ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: ending record exists, so NO is unsupported. The only current-law lead is the 20 U.S.C. 1221 note printing EO 11155 'as amended by' EO 13697, a machine lead without a held CURRENT: record; a printed note does not alone show the amendment is operative through 2026-10-14. Leaning YES; blocked for want of a held CURRENT predicate.
